The maximum value is
\[
\sum_{i=0}^{7}3^i=\frac{3^8-1}{3-1}=3280,
\]
and the minimum is \(-3280\). Balanced ternary with 8 digits represents every integer in \([-3280,3280]\) exactly once. Thus the non-negative integers representable are
\[
0,1,2,\ldots,3280,
\]
which gives \(3281\) integers.

\[
\boxed{3281}
\]
